overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair's emails (a Sept. 4, 2012 query to the Superintendent, a Sept. 14, 2012 distribution of previously read remarks, and an Oct. 10, 2012 billing email) were administrative, not deliberation, though the AG cautioned against copying a quorum on third-party emails.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board deliberated over email outside an open meeting, based on Chair emails sent to the Superintendent and to a quorum of members in fall 2012.
allegations.key_passage: We find that this type of communication is administrative in nature and not deliberation.
